{{Color|Legendary}} }} {{QuoteContainer| {{QuoteBox|description goes here|Shop Description}} }} __TOC__ ==Description== The '''Coin Crate''' is an event [[Crates|crate]]. It has three skins in total. It was first released for [[April Fools 2025 Event]]. Despite its name, it was not available to purchase for {{Coins|Coins}}, it was instead a {{Robux|Robux}} crate. However, its skin could be bought in the [[Daily Store]] using that currency. While it has costs for all four base rarities, only two could be seen. {{Color|Common}} skins had a cost of {{Coins|1,346,914,696}}, {{Color|Uncommon}} skins had a cost of {{Coins|1,346,914,737}}, {{Color|Rare}} skins had a cost of {{Coins|1,346,914,768}} and {{Color|Legendary}} skins had a cost of {{Coins|1,346,914,794}}. ==Methods of Obtaining== #Purchasable in the store for {{Robux|101}}. #Redeem certain [[Codes]]. ==Skins== {| class="light-table align-center pad-5" style="width:300px; margin:0 auto" ! |[[File:AlienFocusCrookBossIconIG.png|175px]] |[[File:TheBeastJesterIconIG.png|175px]] |[[File:TheFleaJesterIconIG.png|175px]] |- !Skin |{{Color|CoinCrate|Alien Focus}} |{{Color|CoinCrate|The Beast}} |{{Color|CoinCrate|The Flea}} |- !Rarity |{{Color|Rare}} |{{Color|Legendary}} |{{Color|Legendary}} |- !Cost |{{Coins|1,346,914,768}} |{{Coins|1,346,914,794}} |{{Coins|1,346,914,794}} |- !Tower |[[Crook Boss]] |[[Jester]] |[[Jester]] |} ==Gallery== {{Gallery| {{GalleryHeader|Miscellaneous}} CoinCrateKey.png|Key used to open the '''Coin Crate'''. }} ==Sounds== {{Sounds| {{{!}} class{{=}}"article-table align-center" style{{=}}"width:750px; margin:0 auto;" {{!}}- ! style{{=}}"width:30%;" {{!}}Sound ! style{{=}}"width:70%;" {{!}}Description {{!}}- {{!}}[[File:CoinCrateOpen.ogg]] {{!}}Opening sound effect {{!}}} }} ==Trivia== *The skins from this crate are the three most expensive items in the game. **These prices were directly copied from the [[Deluxe Crate]]. However, for the [[Deluxe Crate]], these are used to create {{Robux|Robux}} purchases for the skins. For the '''Coin Crate''', it was changed to {{Coins|Coins}}, resulting in extremely high prices. ==Update History== *'''1 April 2025''' - [[v1.59.0]] **'''Coin Crate''' added. *'''18 June 2025''' - [[v1.67.0|v1.67.5]] **'''Coin Crate''' taken offsale. *'''22 April 2026''' - [[v1.89.0]] **Icon added. *'''2 July 2026''' - [[v2.1.0|v2.1.6a]] **{{Bug}} '''Coin Crate''' went onsale. *'''2 July 2026''' - [[v2.1.0|v2.1.6b]] **{{Bugfix}} '''Coin Crates''' no longer has a price. **{{Bug}} Selecting the '''Coin Crate''' in the inventory breaks the inventory UI. *'''2 July 2026''' - [[v2.1.0|v2.1.6c]] **{{Bugfix}} Inventory UI no longer breaks when selected. **{{Bugfix}} '''Coin Crate''' is now offsale. {{CrateNavBox}}
